entries.exceptions: Overrides ALL rules, even biology (das Mädchen).
Gold, Silber, Eisen, Blei, Kupfer. Traps: der Stahl (Masc), die Bronze (Fem).
Greek/Latin multi-syllable disciplines (die Musik, die Politik). Traps: Abitur, Futur (Neut). Trap: 1-syllable English loans take Masc (der Streik → Streiks).
Derived from verbs. Fahrt → Fahrten, Kunst → Künste.
Trap: Masculine weak nouns, Ge- prefix.
Must be human or physical/astronomical loan roots (Magnet, Planet, Komet). Inanimate -ent = Neuter (das Prozent).
Non-human concepts (das Abenteuer, das Ungeheuer, das Steuer).
Professions add -en, Abstract adds -e. Trap: Truncated Latin -atorium loans are Neuter (das Labor → Labors).
Structural suffix. König → Könige, Kiesling → Kieslinge.
Geheimnis → Geheimnisse. Trap: Abstract cognitive/deverbal nouns derived from verbs are Feminine (die Erkenntnis, die Erlaubnis, die Empfängnis, die Ersparnis).

Drops -um / adds -er / adds -e / adds -men / takes Latin -a or -ien (Praktikum → Praktika, Prinzip → Prinzipien). Synthetic/chemical compounds take -it (das Dynamit). Traps: der Reichtum, der Irrtum, der Granit (Masc).
Absolute Masc gravity. Tag, Weg, Zug.
Preis, Fluss, Kuss, Prozess, Kurs, Hals. Traps: Eis, Nuss.
